name: budget-visualization-ui-for-per-issue-spend
title: budget visualization UI for per-issue spend
description: Surface the existing per-issue budget governance (spent / budget / remaining, soft-warn, over-budget) in the frontend so a user can see at a glance how much of an issue's USD ceiling has been consumed and whether the Conductor is in a warning / over-budget state.
creator: jackmouse
notes: Delivered via commit 5aa77fe. Backend: GET /codex/issues/{id}/budget endpoint reusing compute_issue_budget_status (matches the conductor's gating number, not the /cost-stats log-scan figure) + IssueBudgetStatus.to_dict() + 9 unit tests. Frontend: IssueBudgetStatus type, getIssueBudget() API, BudgetMeter component (pure deriveBudgetMeterState for empty/unlimited/healthy/soft_warn/over branches, color-coded), useIssueBudget hook (mount fetch + WS budget_warning/exceeded patch + 30s active-only poll), wired into IssueSideStack's TelemetryCard on the issue detail page. i18n: 8 new zh-CN + en-US keys. Verified all 7 acceptance criteria in prd.md.
